CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple.
   C. Use Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple has no place in daily life.
